usage: Team coins in public/refresh-team.js. The front portrait is shown in grayscale by refresh-team.css; the back is the member's PFP. Kang's front, assets/team/kang-illustration.png, predates this record. Mascot's front was replaced on 2026-11-12.

sources.source: Pasted by the owner in a Claude Code session (PNG, 200×217). The original is kept with the release evidence outside this repository.
sources.edit: Square crop at x35 y10, 150×150; resized to 240×240; JPEG quality 0.9.

sources.source: Supplied by the owner as a local file on 2026-11-12 (JPEG, 633 × 1345, a close-up cropped at the right edge of the head). It replaces the photo supplied on 2026-11-11. The original is kept with the release evidence outside this repository.
sources.edit: Extended on 2026-11-12 to a square head-and-shoulders frame so the head sits at about the scale of the other two portraits: the photo was placed at (460, 105) in a 1680 × 1680 frame and the area around it was generated with Stable Diffusion XL inpainting, run locally (the photo was not sent to an outside service). Generated: the right edge of the hair and cheek and the right ear, the background on both sides and the shoulders. The supplied pixels were pasted back unchanged apart from a blended band about 26 source pixels wide along the seams. A small lamp in the generated background beside the ear, which read as an earring at coin size, was painted over. Resized to 320 × 320; JPEG quality 0.9.
